g.title: j3811700180
g.text: Lyon, I need your help with Roathe.

g.title: j1610572375
g.text: [จบ]

g.text: Check boolean LyonDating

g.title: Chat ends.
g.text: Chat ends.

g.title: j2450350182
g.text: If there is anything I can do to be of assistance, I will do it, mon miracle. What appears to have gone awry between you two?

g.title: j421763245->j2450350182
g.text: true

g.title: j803209359
g.text: If there is anything I can do to be of assistance, I will do it, my friend. What appears to have gone awry between you two?

g.title: j421763245->j803209359
g.text: false

g.title: j1618578127
g.text: Evaluate expressions

g.title: j3981134767
g.text: Roathe has been facing down the truth of his... well... taking the serum. And I don't know how, but I think I did a poor job of helping him through it.

g.title: j1618578127->j3981134767
g.text: RoatheFail

g.title: j1618578127->j3981134767
g.text: RoatheFailStall

g.title: j3523981627
g.text: I'm not sure. I think I said something I shouldn't have.

g.title: j1618578127->j3523981627
g.text: RoatheFailUltimate

g.title: j2868667585
g.text: He told me not to go any farther into his memories. So I haven't. And now we seem... stuck?

g.title: j1618578127->j2868667585
g.text: RoatheFailNot21

g.title: j819897697
g.text: I told him I was only with him for casual companionship, and even though he didn't seem to have a problem with it, now I feel like we've regressed.

g.title: j1618578127->j819897697
g.text: RoatheFailUnloved

g.title: j4187378277
g.text: I see. It can be a difficult thing, to reconcile one's past actions when they are painted in a new light. I curse Entrati for forcing him, and us, into this despicable situation.

g.title: j1911796329
g.text: I see. I fear I must tell you there is little I can do in this matter, as you are experiencing the aftermath of "reaping what one has sewn" in this regard.

g.title: j158835220
g.text: I see. Sometimes, acting in one's best wishes is not the same as following their wishes to the letter of their request.

g.title: j2659468035
g.text: I will do what I can to convince him to listen to you. But I must council you to have better arguments prepared as to why he should reinterpret his actions as anything other than cowardice.

g.title: j2619567436
g.text: Acting with callous disregard in such a fashion is bound to result in behavior that responds in kind. Particularly when you are dealing with one such as Roathe.

g.title: j3740310535
g.text: It is a terrible act we must do, to disobey someone's desires, especially in such a deed as rifling through their private memories and thoughts.

g.title: j1240437235
g.text: For I know that is what eats him whole from the inside out.

g.title: j2141444974
g.text: I do not know what recourse you have to correct matters. But I do not believe you will find a path through Marie nor myself, forgive me.

g.title: j1768323895
g.text: ผมสาปแช่ง Entrati ที่บังคับเขาและพวกเราให้ตกอยู่ในสถานการณ์ที่น่ารังเกียจเช่นนี้

g.title: j634859459
g.text: I know we will also need Marie's assistance in this matter. She may be harder to convince, as you know there is little love lost between those two.

g.title: j968280525
g.text: Perhaps it is best to pursue other options at this point.

g.title: j1557936011
g.text: แต่ดูเหมือนว่าวิธีเดียวที่จะช่วยเขาได้ก็คือต้องทำแบบนั้นจริง ๆ และสำรวจ Descendia ต่อไปจนกว่าจะไม่มีความทรงจำใดหลงเหลืออยู่เลย

g.title: j2692406010
g.text: Boolean LyonRoatheFailFix is now true.

g.title: j3245321851
g.text: ไม่ว่าปีศาจจะคัดค้านอย่างไรก็ตาม

g.title: j3308004919
g.text: Lua guide you.
